error.no_admin: Only an administrator may change this.
candidate.manual.hint: as long as a view is pinned by hand
candidate.guests.hint: as long as guest mode is on
candidate.recipes.hint: as soon as at least one recipe is picked
candidate.schedule.hint: as long as a schedule helper is running
card.error.not_pushed: Rendered, but not pushed — the display did not answer.
card.error.addon: The renderer add-on cannot be reached.
panel.action.render.hint: Redraws and sends it, if anything changed. For changes made outside ePaperEngine: an appointment moved on a phone, a new photo in the folder.
panel.action.push.hint: Sends the same picture once more, even when it has not changed. For when the display missed a push — after a power cut, say — and is stuck on an old state.
panel.overview.manual.hint: overrules the priority until the fallback kicks in
panel.overview.manual.open: No automatic fallback — stays until switched back
panel.overview.actions.hint: Normally nothing is needed here. Saving in this panel redraws the wall by itself, and ePaperEngine looks again every 15 minutes anyway.
panel.overview.preview.hint: this is how the wall looks right now
panel.overview.preview.none: No image yet — the first run creates it.
panel.views.priority.hint: top to bottom — the first active candidate wins
panel.views.fallback.view.hint: applies when no candidate is active
panel.views.schedules.hint: the time windows live in HA schedule helpers — only the rank counts here
panel.views.schedules.overlap: When windows overlap the lowest rank wins — that is not an error.
panel.views.note: Order and fallback are configuration, not code.
panel.photos.root.hint: empty = /media/epaperengine · network storage is mounted below /media
panel.photos.rotation.hint: the picture follows the clock (now // interval), not chance
panel.photos.cache.none: No prepared picture yet — the first run fills the cache.
panel.photos.budget.hint: Keep the photo window tight: on battery the picture frame is what drains it.
panel.display.test.hint: opens TLS:1515 and asks the panel a real question
panel.display.renderer.hint: the display fetches …/content.json and …/image from here itself
panel.display.device.hint: for reference only — not editable here
panel.display.device.name: Model
panel.display.safety.hint: There is only one display. If a test instance runs alongside, the push has to stay off there — otherwise two renderers overwrite each other.
panel.display.push.hint: Off means: everything is rendered, the preview stays current, only the display is left alone. Switching it back on does not push by itself — the next scheduled run does, or „Send image again" on the overview.
panel.recipes.account.hint: the only cloud in this project — the display itself never goes online
panel.recipes.password.set: A password is stored. Only an administrator can read or change it.
panel.recipes.interval.hint: never per render run — the API bans by IP if it is asked too often
panel.recipes.sync.pending: {count} still to fetch — they follow with the next sync.
panel.recipes.selection.hint: up to three at once — three columns is what 2560 px carries
panel.recipes.selection.empty: No recipe picked. The recipe view stays inactive until one is.
panel.recipes.search.hint: searches names and categories in the local cache
panel.recipes.search.empty_cache: The cache is empty — sync first.
panel.recipes.fit.slots.hint: whether the whole recipe fits on the wall with one, two or three up at once
panel.recipes.servings.none: no serving count in Paprika — cannot be scaled
panel.recipes.servings.hint: only the ingredients are recalculated, to one decimal place. Quantities repeated in the directions are left alone — fix those in Paprika.
panel.settings.paths.hint: where the image store lives — typed once, when the storage is mounted
panel.recipes.cache.hint: are the new recipes here yet? The account itself is under Settings.
panel.guests.mode.hint: Exempt from the manual fallback — visitors stay for the weekend, not for four hours.
panel.guests.mode.priority: It only reaches the wall while nothing above it in the priority list is active.
panel.guests.name: Name
panel.guests.font.hint: Starting sizes. A name too long for the width shrinks until it fits; it is never cut.
panel.guests.background.empty: Nothing in the folder yet. Put pictures in and rescan.
panel.guests.check.hint: What breaks is not the stroke width but the contrast against the dither raster of the picture. Remedies in this order: lightened band → a quiet area of the picture → an outline.
panel.guests.color.hint: Six colours, because the panel has six. Anything else would be mixed from these by dithering, and on a letter's edge that shows as speckle instead of a tint.
panel.guests.angle.hint: Positive tilts clockwise, ±45° at most. A tilted name needs more width, so it may end up set smaller than a level one.
panel.guests.outline.hint: A seam around the letters in the counter colour. It makes the greeting readable over any part of the picture — bright or dark — instead of relying on the whole letter to out-contrast it. The third of the three remedies.
panel.guests.outline.width.hint: The width you can see, 2 to 32 px. It grows outwards, so the letterform keeps its weight — but it also widens the block, and a wide seam can cost type size.
panel.calendar.sources.hint: Source-agnostic, through calendar.get_events — Microsoft 365, Google, CalDAV, Local Calendar. What is behind an entity never reaches this page.
panel.calendar.sync.hint: “Recount” reads what Home Assistant already holds. “Sync now” fetches from the sources themselves and redraws the wall — press it after changing an appointment, instead of waiting up to 15 minutes for the timed net.
panel.calendar.sync.done: Synced {time}. The wall is being redrawn — it takes a few seconds.
panel.calendar.sync.other_view: Synced {time}. The wall is showing another view right now, so the calendar picture only changes when it switches back.
panel.calendar.no_entities: Home Assistant knows no calendar entity yet. Add a calendar integration first — Local Calendar, Google, CalDAV or a published ICS through Remote Calendar.
panel.calendar.window.hint: The ceiling of the question, not of the display: the wall shows as many whole days as fit. Birthdays get their own window — one wants time to buy a present.
panel.calendar.bar.hint: 2 px is the measured floor; 6 px reads as a bar rather than a hairline at 1 m. The colours are Spectra primaries — any other value would be dithered into a speckle.
panel.calendar.empty_days.hint: Keeps the run of days gapless. Costs about 126 px — roughly one and a half appointments.
panel.calendar.past_today.hint: Off by default: in the evening the morning's stand-up is noise. Birthdays and all-day entries stay up either way.
